title: Baobab cross-engine event envelope
description: CloudEvents 1.0 structured JSON profile for asynchronous communication between independently deployable Baobab-Platform services.

id.description: Immutable event occurrence identifier. The pair (source, id) is the delivery deduplication key.

type.description: Versioned reverse-DNS event type. The major payload version is the final vN segment.

source.description: Stable absolute URI identifying the logical producer. It must not contain a deployment hostname, credential or tenant secret.

subject.description: Canonical subject within the producer context; never an iDempiere, ERPNext or other vendor-internal identifier.

time.description: UTC timestamp of the business occurrence, not the delivery attempt.

dataschema.description: Immutable URI of the versioned data payload schema.

baobabscope.description: Declares whether tenant context is mandatory. A platform event must never invent a default tenant.

correlationid.description: Stable identifier joining one distributed business interaction.

causationid.description: Identifier of the immediate command or event that caused this occurrence. Omit it for a root event; do not send null.

tenantid.description: Control Plane-minted tenant context. Required when baobabscope is tenant.

idempotencykey.description: Stable originating command key when the event is a consequence of an idempotent command. It does not replace (source, id) for delivery deduplication.

traceparent.description: W3C Trace Context version 00 traceparent value.

tracestate.description: Optional W3C vendor trace state. It must not carry credentials, personal data or business payloads.
